title: Level sets of a measure finite on compact sets are null at almost every level (parent step 4, countable_meas_level_set_pos)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let ν be a measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra of Euclid P) with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be measurable. Then ν({x : f(x) = t}) = 0 for L¹-almost every t ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Measurable f → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ν {x | f x = t} = 0
